items.title: Deadline for special termination right (Sonderkündigungsrecht, § 57 TKG)
items.quote: Sie können Ihren Vertrag innerhalb von drei Monaten nach Zugang dieser Mitteilung ohne Einhaltung einer Frist und ohne Kosten kündigen, frühestens zum Zeitpunkt des Wirksamwerdens der Änderung (§ 57 TKG).
items.computation: The period runs from the day the letter is received (Zugang), not its printed date, and the actual arrival date is not stated in the letter. Using the printed letter date 16.02.2026 (Monday) as a conservative proxy for Zugang: under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of receipt itself is not counted, so counting starts 17.02.2026; under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a 3-month period ends on the day in the third following month that numerically corresponds to the start day, i.e. 16.05.2026. That day is a Saturday; unlike deadlines for filings, a notice/termination right does not shift to the next business day (it must simply reach the provider in time), so the notice should arrive by Friday 15.05.2026 at the latest to be safe. If the letter actually arrived a day or more after 16.02.2026 (e.g. by post), the true deadline would be correspondingly later.

warnings: The three-month special-termination deadline is calculated from the letter's printed date (16.02.2026) because the actual date of receipt (Zugang) is not stated; if the letter arrived later by post, the true deadline for exercising the special termination right would be correspondingly later than 16.05.2026 — confirm the actual delivery date before relying on this deadline.
The Saturday deadline (16.05.2026) does not shift to a business day for a notice of termination, so send the cancellation no later than Friday 15.05.2026 to be safe.
